## Agarican, Toxiphage (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
LN Large plant (fungus)  
**Init** -1; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +13  
**Aura** stench (DC 20, 15 rounds)  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 8, flat-footed 18 (-1 Dex, -1 size, +10 natural)  
**hp** 107 (9d8+35)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +3, **Will** +3  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **Immune** plant traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** slam +7 (1d8+3 plus poison), 2 tentacles +7 (1d6+3 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 8, **Con** 19, **Int** 4, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +18, **CMD** 34  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Improved Stench, Pungent Stench, Toughness, Toxic Stench  
**Skills** Perception +13, Stealth +11  
**Languages** Agaric  


**Special Abilities**


**Chemical Mimicry (Ex)** As a full-round action, a toxiphage can absorb a dose of poison into its body, saving it as a sample. It can indefinitely maintain a number of samples equal to its constitution modifier—absorbing a dose over the limit requires the toxiphage to purge an existing sample from its system, destroying it in the process.
